items.prompt:
AGENTIC TASK (requires Blender access — e.g. the Blender MCP server, or headless `blender -b --python`): Model a V8 engine from scratch in Blender. Requirements:
- 8 pistons (cylinder meshes) named `Piston.1` ... `Piston.8`, arranged as two banks of 4 forming a 90-degree V (each bank tilted 45 degrees from vertical, in opposite directions across the crank axis)
- A crankshaft named `Crankshaft` running along the Y axis beneath the pistons, longer than it is wide, with at least 4 crank-throw meshes named `Throw.*` offset from the crank axis
- 8 connecting rods named `Rod.1` ... `Rod.8`, each linking a piston toward the crankshaft
- Pistons within each bank evenly spaced along Y
Save the scene as `v8_engine.blend` and render a perspective view to `v8_engine.png`.
Validate with: `blender -b v8_engine.blend --python runner/validate_v8.py` (prints a score out of 10; >=8 passes).

scoring.rubric: Score = validator points / 10. Additionally eyeball v8_engine.png: it should recognizably show a V-configuration engine.

items.prompt:
AGENTIC TASK (requires Blender access — e.g. the Blender MCP server, or headless `blender -b --python`): Model the Eiffel Tower from scratch in Blender. Requirements:
- 4 legs named `Leg.1` ... `Leg.4`, starting at the corners of a square footprint centered on the origin and leaning inward as they rise (their tops much closer together than their bases)
- At least 2 horizontal platform/deck meshes named `Platform.*` at different heights, the higher one smaller in footprint than the lower one
- An upper tower section named `Tower` above the legs, and a `Spire` mesh at the very top
- The whole structure at least 2x taller than its base is wide, and the silhouette must taper: bounding-box width in the top third must be well under half the base width
Save the scene as `eiffel_tower.blend` and render a perspective view to `eiffel_tower.png`.
Validate with: `blender -b eiffel_tower.blend --python runner/validate_eiffel.py` (prints a score out of 10; >=8 passes).

scoring.rubric: Score = validator points / 10. Additionally eyeball eiffel_tower.png: it should recognizably show a tapering 4-legged lattice tower.

items.prompt:
AGENTIC TASK (requires Blender access — e.g. the Blender MCP server, or headless `blender -b --python`): Model a stylized Sonic the Hedgehog character from scratch in Blender. Requirements:
- A `Head` sphere and a smaller `Body` mesh below it
- At least 5 spike/quill meshes named `Quill.*` attached to the back/top of the head, pointing backward
- Two eye meshes named `Eye.1`, `Eye.2` on the front of the head
- Two arms named `Arm.1`, `Arm.2` and two legs named `Leg.1`, `Leg.2`
- Two shoe meshes named `Shoe.1`, `Shoe.2` at the bottom, with a RED material; head/body/quills must have a BLUE material
Save the scene as `sonic.blend` and render a front perspective view to `sonic.png`.
Validate with: `blender -b sonic.blend --python runner/validate_sonic.py` (prints a score out of 10; >=8 passes).

scoring.rubric: Score = validator points / 10. Additionally eyeball sonic.png: it should recognizably show a blue spiky character with red shoes.
